profile.name: Muhammad Fachry Alfareeza
profile.tagline: Information Engineering student at Universitas Gadjah Mada, exploring software engineering, data analysis, and practical AI through hands-on projects.
profile.availability: Interested in software, data & applied AI
profile.about: I am an Information Engineering undergraduate at Universitas Gadjah Mada. I build web applications and dashboards, work with Python data workflows, and explore how AI can support practical decision-making. My recent work spans MSME finance, geospatial risk mapping, air-quality data, and energy monitoring. I also completed a fully funded engineering exchange at Kırıkkale University in Türkiye.

projects.name: WeBank-AI
projects.description: An event-driven AI banking-agent prototype for MSME micro-loan assessment from daily cash flow. Includes DSCR risk scoring, HMAC-based privacy proofs, prompt-injection defenses, and data-purging controls. Built for FinTechathon 2026.
